features.note: A distinct square box sits on top of the lower body, so the stacked pass-through silhouette is present. But it reads as a plain matte cube-on-cube, not a stainless wash-chamber cover: no hinge/seam line, no lip or overhang, and the same dark grey as the body. Without any lift/hood detail it reads closer to a stacked cabinet box than the signature raising hood. Below threshold.

Hard fail. Body and hood read as flat DARK MATTE mid-grey, exactly what the spec forbids ('satin, NOT dark matte'). No brushed-metal anisotropy, no satin specular sheen, no bright metallic value — the only element that reads as metal is the thin chrome handle bar. The recessed dark front panel does give a visible wash-chamber opening, but the surface material does not read as brushed 304 stainless at all.

Clear front control interface: dark plastic bezel with a lit green status display and three round buttons, contrasting well against the body. Reads unambiguously as the machine's control panel. Sits a bit low/centre rather than clearly at operator height, but the interface itself is legible and convincing. Above threshold.

defects: Body and hood surface reads as dark matte grey, not brushed satin 304 stainless — the spec's forbidden 'dark matte' look; kills the stainless-body-read feature.
Lift-hood is an undifferentiated plain cube with no hinge line, seam, lip, or overhang, so it reads as a stacked box rather than a raising wash-chamber cover.
Scene/lighting is dim and flat; there is no bright specular or environment reflection to give the metal a stainless read.
Control panel sits low-centre rather than clearly at operator height, though it still reads as an interface.
corrections: Raise material value and add satin/brushed stainless response: brighter base (near #d2d6d8), keep metalness high (~0.9) but ensure the environment/rig produces a visible satin specular sweep so it reads satin, not matte — eliminate the dark-matte appearance entirely.
Strengthen the lift-hood read: add a horizontal seam/hinge line where hood meets body, a small overhang/lip, and slightly differentiate the hood so it reads as a raising cover, not a stacked cube.
Brighten the house-rig / add a fill or environment reflection so the stainless catches light; the current dim flat lighting flattens the metal.
Optionally lift the control panel toward operator height for a stronger ergonomic read.

mechanical.note: Console clean; draws 14/20 and tris 534/60000 both far under budget. tests null. Identical stainless recipe to the v1.8 asset (0xd2d6d8/0.9/0.30 + env 2.15 + frontal fill) which a prior reviewer PASSED at 0.78 — this reviewer reads 0.43 dark-matte.
